topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: The news holds me like a winter chill, the air cold against my skin. Memories of sunlit days stumble in my step, questions tugging at the edges of my mind. How can the past slip through fingers like sand, leaving only traces behind? Yet, in this quiet moment, I find myself smiling at the thought of you, cherishing the laughter we shared, the secrets whispered under the stars. It’s as if those moments, once stitched into the fabric of our lives, now find a new home in my heart, unwavering and warm. I will keep them close, a gentle reminder of the days when the world was ours to explore, and our friendship, a beacon in the night.
